g.text: How Guage Kit measures a system
Samples in, a verdict and a report out. Every number carries an interval; the gate is decided by Ananke Plexus.
1 · Each sample's input goes to your system, which returns an output (or the dataset already has one)
2 · Every applicable metric scores every sample; what a metric needs decides whether it runs
3 · Criteria that need judgement go to a judge, with sample text fenced as untrusted
4 · Per-sample scores become a mean with a 95% interval; two runs become a paired test
5 · Your rules are checked against the numbers; a missing value is never a silent pass
6 · The verdict, every score and every sample land in reports you can open anywhere
